name: Create useful digital maps
description: Turn a practical question about a place into a clear digital map by selecting relevant locations, organising map layers and checking that another person can understand it.

levels.name: Plot a clear map
levels.completion_criterion: Create a digital map showing at least five relevant points in one area, with a title and readable labels.
levels.can_do: Place and label locations in a basic mapping tool.

levels.name: Organise map information
levels.completion_criterion: Create two meaningful layers or categories and choose a useful map extent, scale and set of labels for the question.
levels.can_do: Organise location data so different types of information are easy to inspect.

levels.name: Build a shareable map
levels.completion_criterion: Make a map for a real question, check several locations against independent sources and provide a short note explaining the data and limitations.
levels.can_do: Produce and explain a map that another person can use without additional guidance.

emoji_rationale: A map directly represents the output of the skill.

name: Research and evaluate digital information
description: Find information online using a deliberate search strategy, compare sources and document why the evidence is or is not reliable for a particular question.

levels.name: Search deliberately
levels.completion_criterion: Find answers to one question using at least two different queries and record the source URL for each useful result.
levels.can_do: Turn an information need into focused searches and keep track of useful results.

levels.name: Compare sources
levels.completion_criterion: Compare three sources for authorship, date, evidence and agreement, and explain which is most appropriate for the question.
levels.can_do: Judge the relevance and credibility of digital information rather than trusting the first result.

levels.name: Build an evidence trail
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a short answer supported by at least three traceable sources; distinguish confirmed information from uncertainty and conflicting claims.
levels.can_do: Synthesize sources transparently and explain limitations in the evidence.

emoji_rationale: A magnifying glass suggests investigation and checking evidence.

name: Make sense of a small dataset
description: Use a small table of real or openly available data to organise values, calculate simple summaries, spot patterns and communicate what the data can and cannot show.

levels.name: Organise the data
levels.completion_criterion: Take a dataset with at least 10 rows, identify its columns and units, correct obvious formatting inconsistencies and sort or filter it to answer one question.
levels.can_do: Prepare simple data for inspection without losing track of what each value means.

levels.name: Summarise a pattern
levels.completion_criterion: Calculate at least two suitable summaries or counts, and make a chart or table that answers a stated question.
levels.can_do: Choose simple analytical operations and represent results clearly.

levels.name: Explain limits and findings
levels.completion_criterion: Write a short interpretation that states the main pattern, one alternative explanation or limitation, and one conclusion the data does not justify.
levels.can_do: Separate observed patterns from unsupported causal claims.

emoji_rationale: A data chart is a direct symbol for analysing and interpreting information.

name: Create a 3D-printed object
description: Prepare a simple digital model for additive manufacturing, orient and slice it for a printer, then evaluate the physical result and make a purposeful improvement.

levels.name: Print a prepared model
levels.completion_criterion: Select a small, printer-compatible model, inspect the slicing preview and produce a simple object using the printer instructions.
levels.can_do: Move from a digital file to a physical printed part.

levels.name: Adapt a model
levels.completion_criterion: Change one dimension or a basic feature of a model and successfully print the revised version.
levels.can_do: Make a controlled design change and understand how it affects the result.

levels.name: Iterate a useful design
levels.completion_criterion: Design or substantially adapt a small object, state what it should do, test the printed result and document one evidence-based revision.
levels.can_do: Use printing as an iterative prototyping process rather than only downloading models.

emoji_rationale: A 3D printer is the defining tool of the process.
safety_notes: Follow the printer manufacturer's instructions, use the intended materials, keep ventilation and supervision appropriate to the machine, and never bypass protective features.

name: Observe and identify transport
description: Observe aircraft, trains, buses or ships and record useful identification clues, rather than treating every vehicle type as a separate skill.

levels.name: Make a useful observation
levels.completion_criterion: Record five transport observations with date, location and at least one visible identification clue for each.
levels.can_do: Observe deliberately and keep a consistent field record.

levels.name: Identify with evidence
levels.completion_criterion: Correctly identify at least ten observed vehicles using two or more clues where available, and mark uncertain identifications as uncertain.
levels.can_do: Use observable details and references instead of relying on guesses.

levels.name: Plan a spotting session
levels.completion_criterion: Plan a safe and legal observation session, choose a suitable location, organise notes or photographs and produce a concise log that another enthusiast can interpret.
levels.can_do: Plan, document and review a structured transport-spotting outing.

emoji_rationale: A rail vehicle acts as a recognisable symbol for transport observation as a whole.
safety_notes: Observe from public, safe locations; do not trespass, obstruct operations, or photograph restricted areas. Follow local rules for photography and access.

name: Create and lay out digital content
description: Create a small digital publication by combining text and visual elements, using hierarchy, readable spacing and a consistent layout to make the information easy to follow.

levels.name: Make a clear one-page item
levels.completion_criterion: Create a one-page digital item with a title, short text and at least one visual element, using readable spacing and alignment.
levels.can_do: Combine text and visuals into a coherent digital artefact.

levels.name: Build hierarchy and consistency
levels.completion_criterion: Create a multi-section document or small publication with consistent heading styles, spacing, typography and alignment.
levels.can_do: Use layout conventions to guide readers through information.

levels.name: Publish for a defined audience
levels.completion_criterion: Produce a finished digital publication for a stated audience, check it on at least two screen or output sizes and correct the most important readability issues.
levels.can_do: Adapt a layout to a purpose and verify the final result.

emoji_rationale: A publication represents the combination of digital content and layout.

name: Design clear visual graphics
description: Use composition, contrast, typography, colour and visual hierarchy to communicate one idea clearly in a poster, card or simple digital graphic.

levels.name: Compose a simple graphic
levels.completion_criterion: Create a graphic with one clear message, one focal point and readable text.
levels.can_do: Arrange elements so the main message is immediately understandable.

levels.name: Apply a visual system
levels.completion_criterion: Create a coordinated set of three graphics using consistent typography, colour and spacing.
levels.can_do: Maintain visual consistency across related assets.

levels.name: Design for a real brief
levels.completion_criterion: Create a graphic for a specific audience and format, gather one round of feedback and make at least two purposeful revisions.
levels.can_do: Explain and improve design choices based on communication goals.

emoji_rationale: A brush signals visual design as a creative practice.

name: Observe the night sky
description: Build a repeatable practice of observing the Moon, stars, planets or major sky events and recording what was visible, when and under what conditions.

levels.name: Start a sky log
levels.completion_criterion: Make three observations on different evenings and record date, time, weather and what you can identify with the unaided eye.
levels.can_do: Notice and describe sky objects and changing conditions.

levels.name: Use a reference tool
levels.completion_criterion: Use a reliable star chart or astronomy app to identify at least five objects or sky features, checking observations against the reference.
levels.can_do: Combine direct observation with a sky map or reference.

levels.name: Plan and compare observations
levels.completion_criterion: Plan a short observing session around a target, record conditions and compare observations across at least three dates or sessions.
levels.can_do: Plan observations and recognise how time and conditions affect what is visible.

emoji_rationale: A telescope is a familiar tool for observing celestial objects.
safety_notes: Never look at the Sun through binoculars or a telescope without purpose-built solar equipment and appropriate expert guidance.

name: Observe rocks and geological features
description: Practise noticing, describing and comparing rocks and land features during walks, using careful field notes and reliable references rather than relying on appearance alone.

levels.name: Describe a specimen
levels.completion_criterion: Record observations for three rocks or exposed geological features, including colour, grain or texture and where the observation was made.
levels.can_do: Describe geological features consistently before trying to identify them.

levels.name: Compare and identify
levels.completion_criterion: Use a field guide or trusted reference to propose identifications for five observations and state which clues support each one.
levels.can_do: Compare visible properties against reference descriptions.

levels.name: Create a field record
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a short local geology walk log with a simple location map, photographs or sketches, and a clear distinction between observation and interpretation.
levels.can_do: Document and interpret geological observations responsibly.

emoji_rationale: A rock represents the field observation of geology.
safety_notes: Do not collect samples where prohibited or damage protected geological sites. Avoid cliff edges and unstable terrain.

name: Build simple electronic circuits
description: Explore how electronic components work by assembling and testing low-voltage circuits, then combine inputs or outputs into a small working prototype.

levels.name: Build a simple circuit
levels.completion_criterion: Assemble a battery- or USB-powered LED circuit on a breadboard, using the specified resistor and a documented circuit diagram.
levels.can_do: Connect basic components according to a simple schematic.

levels.name: Add a control or sensor
levels.completion_criterion: Build a low-voltage circuit that reacts to a button, light sensor or other beginner-friendly input and document how it behaves.
levels.can_do: Combine an input with an output and test its behaviour.

levels.name: Make a small prototype
levels.completion_criterion: Create a small low-voltage project with at least two interacting components, troubleshoot one fault and document the final circuit.
levels.can_do: Build, test and explain a simple electronic prototype.

emoji_rationale: A connector represents circuits and components.
safety_notes: Use only beginner low-voltage kits or battery/USB circuits. Do not work on mains-powered devices, power supplies or exposed high-voltage equipment.

name: Listen for distant radio and broadcast signals
description: Practise receiving and identifying distant radio or broadcast stations by recording frequency, time, reception conditions and evidence supporting the identification.

levels.name: Keep a reception log
levels.completion_criterion: Record five received stations with frequency or channel, time, equipment and reception notes.
levels.can_do: Use a consistent method to log stations and listening conditions.

levels.name: Identify distant stations
levels.completion_criterion: Document at least three probable long-distance receptions and compare station identification, location and schedule against a reliable reference.
levels.can_do: Use multiple clues to distinguish a verified station from a guess.

levels.name: Compare propagation conditions
levels.completion_criterion: Repeat observations under different times or conditions and prepare a short summary of how reception changed, with uncertainty noted.
levels.can_do: Use repeated logs to compare reception rather than overstate a single result.

emoji_rationale: A radio directly represents signal reception and listening.
safety_notes: This skill concerns receiving signals only. Transmission requires separate training and compliance with local radio regulations.

name: Observe wildlife and keep field notes
description: Develop a careful field-observation practice by recording visible or audible wildlife clues, using references for identification and respecting the animals and their habitat.

levels.name: Record observations
levels.completion_criterion: Make five wildlife observations with date, location, habitat and a description or photograph of the visible or audible clues.
levels.can_do: Notice and document wildlife without disturbing it.

levels.name: Identify with evidence
levels.completion_criterion: Use a field guide or trusted identification resource to propose identifications for at least five observations and note confidence or uncertainty.
levels.can_do: Use distinguishing clues and references to support an identification.

levels.name: Create a mini-survey
levels.completion_criterion: Repeat observations at a chosen location on three occasions, use the same recording method and summarise what changed without claiming that the sample represents all wildlife there.
levels.can_do: Conduct a modest, repeatable observation exercise.

emoji_rationale: A bird is a recognisable entry point into wildlife observation, without splitting every species into a new skill.
safety_notes: Keep a respectful distance, avoid disturbing nests or breeding behaviour, and follow local wildlife guidance.

name: Research family history
description: Build a documented family-history account from records and interviews, distinguishing evidence from family stories and recording where each claim came from.

levels.name: Start from known facts
levels.completion_criterion: Record a small set of facts about yourself or willing relatives and identify the source for each fact.
levels.can_do: Organise known information before extending a family tree.

levels.name: Verify a relationship
levels.completion_criterion: Use at least two records or a record plus a first-hand account to support one proposed family relationship, noting discrepancies.
levels.can_do: Compare records and assess how well they support a claim.

levels.name: Document a family line
levels.completion_criterion: Create a short family-history summary or chart with source notes, unresolved questions and appropriate privacy choices.
levels.can_do: Produce a traceable account that separates evidence from inference.

emoji_rationale: A family tree is a familiar symbol for genealogy.
safety_notes: Respect living relatives’ privacy and obtain consent before publishing sensitive personal information.

name: Investigate the history of a local place
description: Use records, maps, photographs or respectful site observations to answer a focused question about a neighbourhood, building or local event.

levels.name: Choose a research question
levels.completion_criterion: Write one answerable question about a local place and find two relevant sources or records.
levels.can_do: Turn general curiosity about a place into focused research.

levels.name: Compare historical evidence
levels.completion_criterion: Compare at least three sources of different types, record their dates and origins and identify one uncertainty or contradiction.
levels.can_do: Evaluate historical evidence rather than treating every account as equally reliable.

levels.name: Share a documented finding
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a short illustrated account or map-backed narrative with source notes and a clear separation between evidence and interpretation.
levels.can_do: Communicate a small piece of local history transparently.

emoji_rationale: A historic building represents research into local places and their past.
safety_notes: Respect cemetery rules, private property, memorials and culturally sensitive places. Do not remove objects or disturb graves.

name: Find and document geocaches
description: Use coordinates and clues to plan an outdoor search, find caches responsibly and log the experience while respecting the location and the people who use it.

levels.name: Find a first cache
levels.completion_criterion: Use a geocaching listing and a map or GPS-enabled device to find one cache in a legal, accessible location and log it according to the cache instructions.
levels.can_do: Follow coordinates and hints to navigate to a location.

levels.name: Plan a short outing
levels.completion_criterion: Find three caches on a planned outing, checking access information and choosing a route appropriate to the conditions.
levels.can_do: Combine cache information with practical route planning.

levels.name: Create a responsible cache plan
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a cache description and location plan that considers permissions, accessibility, durability and environmental impact; do not place it without checking the platform rules and land-manager requirements.
levels.can_do: Understand the planning and stewardship involved in a responsible cache.

emoji_rationale: A compass represents navigation and searching outdoors.
safety_notes: Stay on permitted routes, respect property and protected sites, and follow local access rules. Do not hide caches where placement is prohibited.

name: Maintain a healthy aquarium
description: Learn to plan an aquarium around the needs of its inhabitants, monitor water conditions and maintain a stable environment instead of treating fishkeeping as decoration alone.

levels.name: Plan before acquiring fish
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a written plan for one suitable species, including adult size, tank and filtration needs, temperature, diet, social needs and likely ongoing costs.
levels.can_do: Research animal needs before purchasing or accepting fish.

levels.name: Establish and monitor the aquarium
levels.completion_criterion: Set up equipment, follow a fishless-cycling plan and record appropriate water-test results before adding fish.
levels.can_do: Use testing and preparation rather than judging water quality by appearance alone.

levels.name: Maintain stable conditions
levels.completion_criterion: Keep a maintenance log over at least four weeks, record water tests and routine care, and explain what action would be taken if a relevant parameter were outside the species-appropriate range.
levels.can_do: Maintain and assess an aquarium over time.

emoji_rationale: A fish is a direct, easily understood symbol for aquarium care.
safety_notes: Prioritise animal welfare. Do not add fish until the aquarium is prepared and water conditions are appropriate; never release aquarium animals into the wild.

name: Set up personal digital devices
description: Set up a personal computer or digital device by configuring essential settings, installing trusted software and organising files so the device is ready for a defined task.

levels.name: Complete a basic setup
levels.completion_criterion: Set up a personal device or a fresh user profile, connect to a trusted network, review updates and organise a small set of files.
levels.can_do: Follow a reliable sequence for basic device readiness.

levels.name: Install and configure software
levels.completion_criterion: Install or update a trusted application from an official source, configure a useful setting and verify that the intended task works.
levels.can_do: Manage basic software setup and check the result.

levels.name: Prepare a repeatable setup
levels.completion_criterion: Create a short checklist for setting up a device for a defined purpose, including updates, backups, accessibility or privacy settings and a verification step.
levels.can_do: Apply a deliberate configuration process rather than relying on memory.

emoji_rationale: A computer represents everyday device setup.
safety_notes: Use official sources and trusted publishers for software. Do not disable security features just to complete setup.

name: Troubleshoot everyday technology
description: Diagnose simple, non-hazardous problems by describing symptoms, checking likely causes in a safe order and recording what changed.

levels.name: Describe and check a problem
levels.completion_criterion: For a non-hazardous device issue, record the symptom and check power, connections, settings and available error messages before changing anything.
levels.can_do: Diagnose systematically rather than making random changes.

levels.name: Test causes one at a time
levels.completion_criterion: Use a safe troubleshooting checklist to test at least two plausible causes, changing one variable at a time and recording the result.
levels.can_do: Isolate likely causes while keeping track of evidence.

levels.name: Resolve or escalate responsibly
levels.completion_criterion: Resolve a simple issue using documented steps, verify normal operation and explain when the device should be referred to a qualified repairer.
levels.can_do: Know the limits of self-repair and leave a clear record of what was done.

emoji_rationale: Tools represent practical diagnosis and repair without tying the skill to one device model.
safety_notes: Do not open mains-powered equipment, batteries that are damaged or swollen, pressurised systems or devices that can retain dangerous charge. Stop if a repair exceeds your competence.

name: Write and improve small programs
description: Use a programming language to express a simple task, test behaviour and gradually structure a small program that solves a practical problem.

levels.name: Write a small program
levels.completion_criterion: Create and run a short program that accepts or defines an input and produces a useful output.
levels.can_do: Express a simple task in executable instructions.

levels.name: Use control flow and data
levels.completion_criterion: Create a program that uses a condition, a loop and a suitable data structure, then test at least three cases.
levels.can_do: Combine basic programming constructs to handle more than one case.

levels.name: Build a useful mini-project
levels.completion_criterion: Make a small program with a clear purpose, readable structure and instructions for running it; fix at least one bug found through testing.
levels.can_do: Develop, test and explain a small software artefact.

emoji_rationale: A computer is the medium through which programs are created and tested.

name: Contribute to an open-source software project
description: Learn how to make a small, respectful contribution to a public software project by understanding its contribution process, preparing a change and responding constructively to review.

levels.name: Understand a project
levels.completion_criterion: Choose an active project, read its contribution guidance and identify one small, clearly scoped issue or documentation improvement.
levels.can_do: Navigate project conventions before proposing a change.

levels.name: Prepare a contribution
levels.completion_criterion: Make a small change in a fork or branch, follow the project’s style and tests where feasible, and describe the change clearly.
levels.can_do: Prepare an understandable contribution that others can review.

levels.name: Complete the review cycle
levels.completion_criterion: Submit a contribution or draft for review, respond to feedback and document the final outcome, including if the change is declined.
levels.can_do: Collaborate through review without treating acceptance as the sole measure of learning.

emoji_rationale: A network symbol represents shared work across a public software community.
safety_notes: Respect project licensing, community rules, security policies and maintainer guidance. Never upload secrets or private data.

name: Improve a collaborative knowledge project
description: Make a useful, traceable improvement to a public knowledge resource by following its editing rules and supporting factual claims with reliable sources.

levels.name: Make a small correction
levels.completion_criterion: Find a clear typo or simple formatting issue in a project that welcomes such edits, check its editing guidance and make a minimal correction.
levels.can_do: Navigate an existing collaborative editing workflow.

levels.name: Improve content with a source
levels.completion_criterion: Add or improve a factual statement using an appropriate cited source and explain the edit in the summary.
levels.can_do: Connect changes to sources and explain why the edit improves the page.

levels.name: Deliver a structured improvement
levels.completion_criterion: Propose a coherent multi-part improvement, verify its sources and formatting, and respond constructively to feedback from other editors.
levels.can_do: Contribute a documented improvement while respecting community review.

emoji_rationale: A writing symbol represents improving shared knowledge resources.
safety_notes: Respect privacy, copyright, neutral presentation and each project’s specific sourcing and editing rules.

name: Build models from paper and cardboard
description: Turn a flat template or your own plan into a stable three-dimensional model using accurate folds, cuts, tabs and joins.

levels.name: Build from a template
levels.completion_criterion: Assemble a simple paper model from a template, matching the folds and joins and producing a stable finished object.
levels.can_do: Follow a template and make accurate folds and joins.

levels.name: Adapt the structure
levels.completion_criterion: Change one dimension or structural feature of a template and adjust the tabs or joins so the model still assembles.
levels.can_do: Understand how simple design changes affect construction.

levels.name: Design a small model
levels.completion_criterion: Create a paper or cardboard model from your own plan, test its stability and revise at least one weak connection.
levels.can_do: Plan, build and improve a lightweight model.

emoji_rationale: A geometric tool represents measured folds, edges and construction.
safety_notes: Use cutting tools on a stable surface and choose tools appropriate to your experience.

name: Assemble and finish scale models
description: Assemble and finish a small scale model with attention to fit, alignment, surface preparation and consistent finishing.

levels.name: Assemble a basic kit
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a small kit following its instructions, check alignment and correct visible gaps that affect assembly.
levels.can_do: Follow a build sequence and fit components together.

levels.name: Improve surface and finish
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare surfaces, apply an appropriate finish and use at least one careful detailing technique on a model.
levels.can_do: Improve appearance through controlled preparation and finishing.

levels.name: Plan and document a build
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a more complex model, organise the build sequence, document a challenge and explain how you improved fit or finish.
levels.can_do: Manage a model project through assembly, finishing and review.

emoji_rationale: A model-piece symbol represents assembling a multi-part miniature.
safety_notes: Follow product safety instructions for adhesives, paints and solvents; provide appropriate ventilation and avoid unsuitable products for children.

name: Design and build a working model mechanism
description: Construct a small model that demonstrates a mechanical principle, using a measured plan, moving parts and repeatable tests.

levels.name: Make a simple moving model
levels.completion_criterion: Build a small model with one intended moving part and demonstrate that it moves as designed.
levels.can_do: Translate a simple mechanical idea into a physical model.

levels.name: Adjust fit and motion
levels.completion_criterion: Measure a fit or motion problem, change one design dimension and test whether the mechanism works more reliably.
levels.can_do: Use measurement and iterative adjustment to improve a mechanism.

levels.name: Build and explain a mechanism
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a model with two interacting mechanical elements and explain how motion transfers through the design, supported by a sketch or diagram.
levels.can_do: Design, test and explain a small working mechanism.

emoji_rationale: A gear represents mechanisms and functional model engineering.
safety_notes: Use suitable hand tools and low-risk materials; do not operate industrial machinery without training and supervision.

name: Make figures from modelling balloons
description: Shape modelling balloons into simple figures by controlling inflation, twist sequence and the order in which sections are formed.

levels.name: Make a basic shape
levels.completion_criterion: Inflate a modelling balloon appropriately and create a simple two- or three-part figure without uncontrolled twisting.
levels.can_do: Control balloon pressure and basic twists.

levels.name: Combine several sections
levels.completion_criterion: Create a recognisable figure with at least four connected sections while keeping the twists stable.
levels.can_do: Plan a sequence of shapes and maintain their structure.

levels.name: Create a design from a plan
levels.completion_criterion: Reproduce a more complex figure from a visual plan and adjust proportions or joints to improve its stability.
levels.can_do: Follow and adapt a multi-step balloon design.

emoji_rationale: A balloon is the defining material for this hand skill.
safety_notes: Avoid overinflation and keep broken balloon pieces away from young children and pets.

name: Play backgammon strategically
description: Develop backgammon skill by applying legal moves, weighing risk and probability, and reviewing decisions rather than relying only on luck.

levels.name: Play a legal game
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a game while making legal moves and correctly applying the basic movement and bearing-off rules.
levels.can_do: Apply core rules without repeated prompting.

levels.name: Explain strategic choices
levels.completion_criterion: During a game, explain the reason for at least three choices involving safety, blocking or race position.
levels.can_do: Relate individual moves to the board position and likely consequences.

levels.name: Review a decision
levels.completion_criterion: Review a completed game, identify two decisions that changed risk or position and compare an alternative move using the same position.
levels.can_do: Use post-game analysis to improve future decisions.

emoji_rationale: Dice are central to the backgammon decision process.

name: Create and play collaborative role-playing stories
description: Create a character, make meaningful choices within shared rules and help a group build a coherent story through collaborative role-playing.

levels.name: Create a playable character
levels.completion_criterion: Create a character with a goal, a limitation and a simple way to participate in a short game.
levels.can_do: Build a character that can make meaningful choices in a shared story.

levels.name: Contribute to a session
levels.completion_criterion: Take part in a short session, make choices consistent with the character and leave space for other players to contribute.
levels.can_do: Collaborate with others rather than attempting to control the whole story.

levels.name: Facilitate a short scenario
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare and run a short beginner-friendly scenario with a clear starting situation, meaningful choices and an ending, then gather feedback.
levels.can_do: Structure a shared story and guide a group through it.

emoji_rationale: A theatre-mask symbol represents taking roles and building a shared fictional situation.
safety_notes: Agree on boundaries and expectations before play; respect other participants and their comfort.

name: Explain science to a general audience
description: Translate a science-related topic into an accurate and accessible explanation for people without specialist knowledge, clearly separating evidence from uncertainty.

levels.name: Explain one concept clearly
levels.completion_criterion: Explain a science-related concept in 150–250 words or a two-minute talk, defining specialist terms and using one concrete example.
levels.can_do: Translate technical language without losing the central idea.

levels.name: Support an explanation
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a short explanation with at least two traceable sources and distinguish established findings from uncertainty or disagreement.
levels.can_do: Use sources and caveats to preserve accuracy for a general audience.

levels.name: Adapt for an audience
levels.completion_criterion: Create two versions of the same explanation for different audiences or formats and justify the changes in vocabulary, examples and emphasis.
levels.can_do: Adapt scientific communication while retaining factual accuracy.

emoji_rationale: A microphone represents communicating scientific ideas to an audience.

name: Grow plants from seed
description: Choose appropriate seeds, sow them at suitable depth and spacing, maintain germination conditions and document seedling growth.

levels.name: Sow a small batch
levels.completion_criterion: Sow a suitable seed according to its packet instructions, label the container with the name and date, and keep the growing medium appropriately moist.
levels.can_do: Follow basic sowing guidance and track what was planted.

levels.name: Care for seedlings
levels.completion_criterion: Record germination and growth observations over two weeks, adjusting light and watering according to the plant’s needs.
levels.can_do: Monitor seedlings and respond to their conditions.

levels.name: Raise and transplant seedlings
levels.completion_criterion: Raise a small batch to transplantable size, move them with minimal root disturbance and document the aftercare plan.
levels.can_do: Manage early plant growth and adapt care as plants develop.

emoji_rationale: A seedling symbolises the progression from sowing to growth.
safety_notes: Choose non-invasive species appropriate to the local area and follow the seed supplier’s growing guidance.

name: Fly a kite with control
description: Choose a suitable open location and weather, launch a kite safely, control its line and recover it without endangering people or wildlife.

levels.name: Launch in suitable conditions
levels.completion_criterion: Choose an open, permitted area and moderate conditions, then launch and land a simple kite under control.
levels.can_do: Recognise basic flying conditions and manage launch and recovery.

levels.name: Control the flight
levels.completion_criterion: Maintain a stable flight and make deliberate line adjustments to change the kite’s position without losing control.
levels.can_do: Control line tension and respond to wind changes.

levels.name: Plan a responsible session
levels.completion_criterion: Plan a session around forecast conditions, airspace and local rules, and choose a safe recovery procedure if wind increases.
levels.can_do: Anticipate conditions and prioritise safe control over altitude or spectacle.

emoji_rationale: A kite directly represents this outdoor skill.
safety_notes: Never fly near power lines, roads, airports or storms; follow local airspace and site rules and avoid lines or locations that could endanger wildlife.
